newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury's seen hit by profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury's seen hit by profit warning.

text.p: Shares in supermarket group J Sainsbury were expected by market makers in the stock to open sharply lower on Friday after the company said annual pretax profits were likely fall short of consensus estimates by around 150 million stg.
The shares closed at 392p on Thursday.
Sainsbury said in its January trading statement that sales over the eight week Christmas trading period were up 4.4 percent on a like-for-like basis.

The group added that the cost of building sales would impact on profits, with current year profit expected to be between 640-650 million stg, before a 50 million stg integration provision of Texas, the home improvements chain.
According to the Estimate Directory, analysts had been expecting profits of around 760 million stg for the current year.
